g.text: Means in 10° bins of the longitude at the centre of the disc. Shaded bands: the Pacific (−180° to −140°) and Africa (0° to 40°) views compared in the titles. Land share from NOAA's 0.25° land-sea mask, weighted by sunlight and viewing

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: angle (cos θ₀ cos θ). (c) is smoothed over 30°: frame-to-frame tone adjustments (README) make single 10° bins jump by ~3%. Linear light at gamma 1.8; the colour contrast is 11% in raw display units and 20% at gamma 2.4.
